    Pair-position string detectors #

    Ringel's filtration uses a detector at every split position of a string. At a vertex u, such a split is represented by endpoint words with opposite polarizations. This file packages the corresponding subquotient

    (L⁺ ∩ R⁺) / ((L⁺ ∩ R⁻) + (L⁻ ∩ R⁺))

    and its functorial action. The detector already used in the campaign is the special case in which L is the oppositely polarized trivial word.
